title: Smoother Shadow Checkers
summary: More responsive piece selection and camera movement, lighter rendering, and improved music recovery.

sections.heading: Shadow Checkers
items: Switch or deselect pieces reliably, including when another piece must capture.
The 3D room targets smoother motion with lower rendering overhead and more responsive camera controls.
Music recovers after browser audio interruptions; changing game modes keeps the fullscreen view.
Kings now animate a complete capture loop even when they finish on their starting square.
Restart to load this update in the Home Screen app or TestFlight.
